talents.name: Power in Light

ranks.description: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 2% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Rank badge 0/5.

talents.name: Wand Specialization

ranks.description: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic maxRank 5 at +5%/rank; Forever maxRank 2 showing +13% at rank 1.

talents.name: Twin Disciplines

ranks.description: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only.

talents.name: Silent Resolve

ranks.description: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 10% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 5%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: all-spell threat −4%/rank max 5. Forever: Holy-only threat −10% + CC duration −5%, maxRank 3.

talents.name: Holy Precision

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Rank 0/3 tooltip shows 6% (rank-1 effect).

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield

ranks.description: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 7%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 +5% absorb; Forever +7%. Arrow down to Soul Warding.

talents.name: Martyrdom

ranks.description: Gives you a 50% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

talents.diffNotes: Adds Interrupt resistance +20% to Focused Casting vs Classic foundation text.

talents.name: Mental Agility

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: instant-cast only −2%/rank max 5. Forever includes Smite/Holy Fire, −3%, maxRank 3.

talents.name: Inner Focus

ranks.description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Inner Focus effect text.

talents.name: Meditation

ranks.description: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was 5% (then 10/15). Forever shows 17% at rank 1.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire

ranks.description: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 15% and increases its total charges by 4.

talents.iconHint: Open book/tome or Inner Fire glyph
talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 +10% armor only. Forever +15% armor and +4 charges.

talents.name: Mental Strength

ranks.description: Increases your total Intellect by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic increased maximum Mana by 2%/rank. Forever increases total Intellect by 3%/rank.

talents.name: Soul Warding

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Requires Improved Power Word: Shield; arrow continues to Renewed Hope.

talents.name: Improved Mana Burn

ranks.description: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 −0.25 sec. Forever −0.5 sec.

talents.name: Penance

ranks.description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 98 Holy damage to an enemy, or 258 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Long arrow down to Power Infusion.

talents.name: Renewed Hope

ranks.description: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal and Penance gain 2% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 1 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Rank badge 0/5. Requires Soul Warding; arrow to Divine Aegis.

talents.name: Divine Aegis

ranks.description: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 5% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Requires Renewed Hope.

talents.name: Power Infusion

ranks.description: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Effect % matches Classic; Forever requires Penance (not Mental Strength); shows 173 mana / 3 min CD.

talents.name: Twilight Focus

ranks.description: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only name (not Classic Healing Focus). Applies to any spell; maxRank 3; spent 3/3.

talents.name: Improved Renew

ranks.description: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Improved Renew rank 1 (+5%).

talents.name: Holy Specialization

ranks.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 3%.
Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 4%.

talents.iconHint: Hand reaching for light / holy seal
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic +1%/rank Holy crit. Spent 3/5.

talents.name: Spell Warding

ranks.description: Reduces all spell damage taken by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Shield with white cross / ward figure
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Spell Warding rank 1.

talents.name: Divine Fury

ranks.description: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Divine Fury at max (0.5 sec). Arrow to Searing Light.

talents.name: Holy Nova

ranks.description: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 32 to 37 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 11 yards and healing all party members within 11 yards for 75 to 85. These effects cause no threat.

talents.diffNotes: Forever shows concrete values (185 mana, 32–37 dmg, 75–85 heal, 11 yd) vs Classic placeholders.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery

ranks.description: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

talents.diffNotes: Adds >30% max HP single-hit trigger and refresh carryover vs Classic crit-only text.

talents.name: Inspiration

ranks.description: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

talents.iconHint: Hand with sparkles / white light orb
talents.diffNotes: Wording: non-periodic critical heals; 25% at 3/3 matches Classic max armor buff magnitude.

talents.name: Holy Reach

ranks.description: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.
Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Holy Reach 10%/20%. Spent 1/2.

talents.name: Improved Healing

ranks.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Adds Penance and Prayer of Mending vs Classic Lesser/Heal/Greater only.

talents.name: Searing Light

ranks.description: Increases your Holy damage done by 2%, and gives a 5% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: Smite/Holy Fire damage +5%/rank. Forever: general Holy damage + Holy Nova free-cast proc. Requires Divine Fury.

talents.name: Binding Heal

ranks.description: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 382 to 443. Low threat.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only.

talents.name: Litany of Light

ranks.description: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Spent 2/2.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption

ranks.description: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.diffNotes: Duration 15 sec vs Classic 10 sec. Arrow down to Prayer of Mending.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance

ranks.description: Increases your spell healing by up to 20% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 6% of your total Spirit.
Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

talents.diffNotes: Classic unified spell damage and healing up to 5% Spirit/rank. Forever splits heal/damage coefficients. Spent 4/5.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing

ranks.description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 7%.
Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever maxRank 3 (Classic 5 at +2%/rank). Spent 2/3 showing 7%.

talents.name: Prayer of Mending

ranks.description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 263 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only capstone. Requires Spirit of Redemption. Replaces Classic Lightwell slot.

talents.name: Shadow Focus

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with your Shadow spells by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic reduced target resist by 2%/rank. Forever +1% hit/rank. Placed row0 col0.

talents.name: Blackout

ranks.description: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Blackout. Arrow to Improved Psychic Scream; center chain continues to Vampiric Embrace → Shadowform.

talents.name: Spirit Tap

ranks.description: Gives you a 20% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target. For the duration, your Mana will regenerate at a 50% of normal rate while casting.

talents.diffNotes: Wording updated (non-trivial; 50% of normal rate). Placed row0 col2.

talents.name: Shadow Affinity

ranks.description: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 −8% threat. Forever −10%.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain

ranks.description: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic +3 sec. Placed col2 (Classic col1); center col empty for Blackout chain.

talents.name: Shadow Reach

ranks.description: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic +6%/rank max 3. Forever +10% offensive Shadow, maxRank 2, tier-2 col3.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic −0.5 sec/rank.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 2 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic. Requires Blackout (arrow).

talents.name: Mind Flay

ranks.description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 108 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

talents.diffNotes: Damage value 108 vs Classic 75. Horizontal arrow to Improved Mind Flay.

talents.name: Improved Mind Flay

ranks.description: Your Mind Flay now deals 10% more damage, gains 5 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 35%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Requires Mind Flay.

talents.name: Improved Fade

ranks.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic −3 sec/rank.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace

ranks.description: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. Vampiric Embrace also grants a chance for your Spirit Tap talent to trigger when enemies afflicted by it die.

talents.diffNotes: Adds Spirit Tap-on-VE-death clause. Arrow down to Shadowform.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving

ranks.description: Your Shadow damage spells have a 33% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: target Shadow vulnerability stacks maxRank 5. Forever: self damage buff stacks, maxRank 3.

talents.name: Silence

ranks.description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Adds interrupt-spellcasts-for-3-sec clause vs Classic silence-only.

talents.name: Devouring Contagion

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 25%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 5 yards for the remaining duration.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only.

talents.name: Early Demise

ranks.description: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Directly under Silence.

talents.name: Darkness

ranks.description: Increases your Shadow damage done by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic +2% Shadow damage per rank.

talents.name: Shadowform

ranks.description: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

talents.diffNotes: Classic +15% Shadow / −15% Physical only. Forever adds −50% Shadow mana and +100% Shadow crit damage; Shadow damage bonus now 10%. Requires Vampiric Embrace.

summary.layoutNotes: Slots confirmed against overview.png and Priest_talents.png; tooltips from Forever collages.
remainingUncertainty: Holy Precision Rank 0/3 tooltip shows 6% hit; expanded as 6/12/18 (may be intended 2/4/6 if UI showed max).
Meditation Rank 0/3 shows 17%; expanded as ~17/33/50 (Classic was 5/10/15).
Multi-rank passives with only one collage rank use linear extrapolation for missing ranks.
Improved Mind Flay rank 2 slow (20%) is extrapolated; only rank 1 (35% slow) is screenshot-confirmed.
Spiritual Guidance ranks 1-3 interpolated from screenshot ranks 4-5 (20%/6% and 25%/8%).
Penance values from Disc.forever collage (98 dmg / 258 heal / 2 sec); a crop fragment showed different numbers.
Live tree name kept as Shadow (not Shadow Magic) for backgrounds/priest/shadow.jpg.
